overview: Host Danielle Balocca interviewed Brianna Laquadara about the founding of her nonprofit, Defend Our Community, and its upcoming fundraiser. The discussion highlighted activism as a response to community challenges and the specific organizations benefiting from the event.

items.title: Guest Introduction and Local Favorites
items.summary: Brianna Laquadara introduced herself as an aesthetic nurse and founder of Defend Our Community before recommending Rasso's and Pho Town as local dining spots.

items.title: Foundation of Defend Our Community
items.summary: Laquadara explained how her nonprofit grew from a personal desire to engage in activism into a network of 52 vendors supporting marginalized groups.

items.title: Partner Organizations and Mission
items.summary: The nonprofit works to support Embrace Boston, GLAAD, and the MIRA Coalition to advance rights for BIPOC, LGBTQ+, and immigrant communities.

items.title: April 30 Fundraiser Details
items.summary: A large-scale fundraiser is scheduled for April 30, 2026, at Artists for Humanity in Boston, featuring vendors, drag performances, and $20,000 in raffle prizes.

items.title: Recruitment and Medford Impact
items.summary: The organization is seeking board members and increased participation from Medford residents to strengthen local community support networks.

items.title: Event Logistics and Donations
items.summary: The interactive fundraiser will offer dinner, cocktails, and networking opportunities, with tickets and donation options available on the nonprofit's website.
